rule: Initial initiative winner and cyclic seat order stay fixed for every cycle; insolvent seats are skipped without rotating the anchor.

browserTests.assertion: Both browser paths verify the same first fund starts cycle 2 after Context reading/confirmation; another fund plays the intervening turn.

saveCompatibility: No schema migration. Legacy saves freeze their currently persisted starter anchor and keep the current turn; unrecorded initial tie-break results are not inferred.
review: Independent engine review found no concrete phase, Context, detention, endgame or save regression. Parameterized tests use actual controlled highest opening die for 2..6 seats over three cycles; additional cases cover JSON resume and bankrupt starter.
